en: The postcard features a colorful illustrated map of northern Germany centered on the Nord-Ostsee-Kanal (Kiel Canal), showing towns, the canal's route, bridges, and ship icons. Around the map are photographic images of various sections of the canal, including ships traversing through locks and passing under bridges. The central text clearly labels 'NORD-OSTSEE-KANAL' with city and regional coats of arms above. The map also references cities such as Kiel, Rendsburg, and Brunsbüttel, and major connections between the North Sea (Elbe) and the Baltic Sea (Ostsee).
